blocks.text: Ek circuit lein jis mein coil, battery, switch aur rheostat series mein jure hain (Fig. 17.18). Rheostat ko tezi se hilayen to coil mein current badalta hai, coil ka magnetic flux bhi badalta hai, aur is se khud usi coil mein emf paida (induce) hoti hai.

blocks.title: Self-induction
blocks.text: Jab kisi coil mein badalta current usi coil ke andar emf paida kare, to is amal ko self-induction kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Lambi coil jo switch, battery aur rheostat ke saath series mein hai; current I circuit mein ghoomta. Primary current ki magnetic field lines coil se guzarti hain, chakkaron ke gird chhote gol teer. Labels primary current, aik chakkar mein induced current aur coil par induced emf dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.18: Coil khud apne andar induced current aur induced emf paida karti hui (kitab ki Figure 17.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rheostat tezi se hilane par current badalta hai, is liye coil ka apna flux badalta hai aur usi coil mein ulti emf (induced emf) paida hoti hai. Yeh emf current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalfat karti hai; isi ko self-induction kehte hain.
Farz karein coil ke ek chakkar (loop) se flux φ guzarta hai; N chakkaron se kul flux Nφ hai. φ magnetic field ke mutabiq hai aur magnetic field current I ke mutabiq, is liye:
Yahan L ek constant hai jise coil ki self-inductance kehte hain.
Self-inductance L in cheezon par munhasir hai:

items: Core ka madda: coil ko ferromagnetic lohe ke core par lapeten to magnetic flux, aur is liye inductance, hawa wale core ke muqable mein bohat barh jati hai.

blocks.text: Faraday's law ke mutabiq coil mein paida emf:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Eq. (17.28)' ka hawala deti hai; asal mein Nφ = LI wali equation (17.29) istemal ho rahi hai.

Yahan L coil ki self-inductance hai aur minus ka nishan batata hai ke paida emf lagaye gaye voltage (current ki tabdeeli) ki mukhalfat karti hai (Lenz's law). Agar ε_L = 1 volt aur ΔI/Δt = 1 A s⁻¹ ho to L = 1 henry (H):

blocks.title: Henry
blocks.text: Agar coil mein current 1 A s⁻¹ ki raftar se badle aur coil mein 1 V emf paida ho, to coil ki self-inductance 1 henry (H) hai.
Self-inductance ko emf aur usi coil mein current badalne ki raftar ki nisbat bhi keh sakte hain. L ki SI unit V s A⁻¹ (henry) hai aur dimensions [ML²T⁻²A⁻²] hain.

blocks.title: Example 17.8
blocks.problem: Ek coil ki 50 Hz frequency par inductive reactance 160 Ω hai. Coil ki self-inductance nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: X_L = 160 Ω, f = 50 Hz

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab hal ki pehli line mein 'Induced reaction' aur 'f = 59 Hz' chhapti hai. Sahi 'inductive reactance' aur f = 50 Hz hai (sawal mein bhi 50 Hz hai aur hisaab bhi 50 Hz se hua hai).
Inductor mein jama energy

Ek coil battery aur switch ke saath series mein lagi hai (Fig. 17.19). Switch ON karne par coil par voltage lagta hai aur current zero se barh kar maximum tak jata hai. Current badalne se coil mein battery ke ulat emf paida hoti hai. Is ulti emf ke khilaf charges ko chalane ke liye battery kaam (work) karti hai.

blocks.alt: Switch ke zariye battery se juri coil; current I coil ke aik sire mein jata aur doosre se nikalta. Coil ke dono siron se magnetic field lines phailti hain. Mura hua surkh teer induced current dikhata hai jo I ke barhne ki mukhalfat karta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.19: Inductor mein jama tawanai maloom karne ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan Δq/Δt average current hai. Current 0 se barh kar I tak jata hai, is liye average:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan (0+1)/2 chhapti hai; sahi (0 + I)/2 = ½I hai (1 nahi, current I).
Eq. 17.35 mein qeematen rakhne se:
Yeh kaam inductor mein potential energy ban kar jama ho jata hai:

Yaad rahe: inductor mein energy magnetic field mein jama hoti hai aur kabhi negative nahi hoti, kyunke yeh current ke square ke mutabiq hai. Inductor power lete waqt energy jama karta hai aur power dete waqt wahi energy wapas karta hai. Ab Eq. 17.37 ko solenoid ke magnetic field B ki shakal mein likhte hain:

items: n = fi unit lambai chakkaron ki tadaad
A = coil ke cross-section ka area
B = solenoid ka magnetic field = μₒnI
L = self-inductance = μₒn²Al, jahan l solenoid ki lambai hai

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is list mein B ko 'Negative field' likhti hai (sahi: solenoid ka magnetic field) aur current ko B/μₒnI likhti hai (ek I zyada); sahi I = B/μₒn hai.
Eq. 17.37 mein yeh qeematen rakhne se:

blocks.text_alt: As Al = volume, so Uₘ = B² (1/2μₒ)(volume)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is line mein Uₘ/volume = (1/μₒ)B² chhapti hai, yani 2 reh gaya. Sahi B²/(2μₒ) hai, jaisa oopar wali line aur Eq. 17.38 dikhati hain.
Solenoid ke andar fi unit volume jama energy Uₘ ko energy density kehte hain:

blocks.prompt: 0.5 H ke inductor mein 2 A current ho to kitni energy jama hai?
blocks.explanation: Uₘ = ½LI² = ½ × 0.5 H × (2 A)² = 1 J.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Self-induction: Nφ = LI; ε_L = −L ΔI/Δt (tabdeeli ki mukhalfat).
L chakkaron, area aur core par munhasir; 1 H = 1 V s A⁻¹.
Energy Uₘ = ½LI²; energy density = B²/(2μₒ).
